2607.05276.title: ProPS: Prompted Profile Synthesis for Natural Language-Conditioned Speaker Embedding Distributions
2607.05276.paper_summary: Speaker embeddings, or x-vectors, are widely used to represent speaker identity and speaker-related attributes, but existing embedding extractors are typically descriptive rather than generative: they map an observed speech segment to an x-vector, which is then used for downstream applications. We introduce ProPS, Prompted Profile Synthesis, a framework for generating distributions of speaker embeddings conditioned on natural language prompts such as "a thirties male speaker with an Indian accent". ProPS converts human-written profile descriptions into sentence embeddings and uses a mixture density network trained on a large-scale dataset to predict a Gaussian mixture model in the x-vector space. The model is trained by maximizing the likelihood that real speaker embeddings match the requested profile, and its generated distributions are evaluated by negative log-likelihood on held-out x-vectors and by attribute classification accuracies on sampled synthetic x-vectors. Experiments show that ProPS produces profile-conditioned distributions and generates x-vectors that preserve requested speaker attributes such as age, gender, accent, and prosodic characteristics. This design enables controllable speaker-profile synthesis for speech generation systems like Text-To-Speech (TTS) or Voice Conversion (VC) while anchoring generated distributions in observed speaker-embedding structure.
2607.05276.paper_summary_zh: 說話者嵌入，或稱為 x-vectors，被廣泛用於表示說話者身份和與說話者相關的屬性，但現有的嵌入提取器通常是描述性的而非生成性的：它們將觀察到的語音片段映射到一個 x-vector，然後該 x-vector 用於下游應用。我們介紹 ProPS，Prompted Profile Synthesis，一個生成以自然語言提示為條件的說話者嵌入分佈的框架，例如「一位有印度口音的三十多歲男性說話者」。ProPS 將人類撰寫的個人資料描述轉換為句子嵌入，並使用在大規模數據集上訓練的混合密度網絡來預測 x-vector 空間中的高斯混合模型。該模型通過最大化真實說話者嵌入與請求的個人資料匹配的可能性來進行訓練，其生成的分佈通過在保留的 x-vectors 上的負對數似然和在抽樣的合成 x-vectors 上的屬性分類準確性進行評估。實驗顯示 ProPS 生成以個人資料為條件的分佈，並生成保留請求的說話者屬性，如年齡、性別、口音和韻律特徵的 x-vectors。這一設計使得可控的說話者個人資料合成成為可能，適用於語音生成系統，如文本轉語音 (TTS) 或語音轉換 (VC)，同時將生成的分佈固定在觀察到的說話者嵌入結構中。
